issue.title: Pager navigation teardown fails with pytest 9.2 when undoing forwarded notify patches
issue.description: Found by sase-1ou.6.land--3 while auditing the post-repair scheduled Full CI runs 40976564464 (f94ad24a4a) and 41011050293 (20dc76bd09). Both contain the Files repair but this failure is independent. Exact excerpts: file:explicit:26a0e166c4b017177f87eabb. All-status exact/semantic searches and past-week task sweep found no duplicate; reviewed active epics and found no demonstrated causal owner. Reproduce with pytest9.2.0 and repair the patch target or proxy undo semantics while preserving toast assertions. Do not treat the older pytest focused pass as evidence CI is fixed. Root location: src/sase/pager/_screen_host.py and tests/pager/test_app_navigation.py. This differs from view-release timeout task sase-1ps.

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: Both schedules error on teardown for this node and test_past_eof_end_line_clamps_silently in all three Python jobs: AttributeError: PagerScreen has no attribute notify. CI installs pytest9.2.0; local pytest9.1.1/Textual8.0.1 passes both. The test and PagerScreen source are byte-identical to CI. PagerScreen forwards notify writes to the focused view through __setattr__ but has no matching deletion forwarding; inspect pytest9.2 monkeypatch undo against this proxy.

issue.creation_reason: Two scheduled CI audits independently expose this failure outside the Files navigation epic; record it for repair without blocking that epic.
